parts:
I added Jonah Sol Gabry, the coder behind ShinyStan, to
our core development team list.

Should we be more active at moving people from active
to alumni contributors? Maybe after a year of no commits?

Michael Malecki and Yuanjun Guo have already made the move,
and they'd be joined by Matt Hoffman under the one-year
plan.

- Bob
